title: 23 ## PATTERN OF IPC CRIMES: 1.4 Percentage share of crimes committed under the important crime-heads during the years 1988 to 1992, given in Table-3, shows that for most of the IPC crimes, the pattern in 1992 was more or less similar to the preceding years. However, in case of ‘Burglary’, ‘Theft’ and ‘Riots’, the percentage share has been decreasing while for ‘Murder’, ‘Attempt To Commit Murder’ and ‘Counterfeiting’, it has been increasing. ‘Other IPC crimes’ constituted 55.6 per cent of the total crimes.
